title: A green synthesis of zinc oxide nanoparticles using Musa Paradisiaca and Rooibos extracts
author: Lyimo, Ajayi, et al.

steps.title: Prepare banana peel extract
steps.instruction: Wash and rinse banana peels with distilled water, dry them, slice thinly, then extract by boiling and processing the mixture.

substeps.instruction: Wash and rinse the banana peels with distilled water.
Cut the dried peels into thin slices.
Combine 100 g of sliced peels with 300 ml distilled water in a flask.
Boil the mixture at 70 °C for 30 min while stirring magnetically.
Cool the boiled mixture naturally to room temperature (25 °C).
Pour the cooled mixture gently into a centrifuge tube.
Transfer the clear supernatant (banana peel extract) to a clean, well‑labelled glass bottle, leaving any precipitate behind.
Store the stock extract at 4 °C until further use.

steps.title: Prepare Buchu‑infused Rooibos extract
steps.instruction: Extract bioactive compounds from a Rooibos‑Buchu leaf mixture by boiling, cooling, and centrifugation, then store the clear extract.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 5 g of a Rooibos‑Buchu ground leaf mixture (ratio 4:1).
Dissolve the 5 g leaf mixture in 100 ml distilled water in a clean container.
Boil the solution at 80 °C for 2 h while stirring mechanically at 1000 rpm.
Allow the boiled solution to cool naturally to room temperature (25 °C).
Pour the cooled solution gradually out of the container.
Centrifuge the solution at 1000 rpm for 15 min.
Collect the clear supernatant (Rooibos‑Buchu extract) into a clean storage bottle, leaving insoluble material behind.
Store the stock extract at 4 °C until further use.
